capabilities: search emojis with fuzzy and semantic matching
insert emojis into the editor via click or keyboard
toggle Twitter emoji formatting for preview and insert
problem: Obsidian has no built-in emoji picker, so finding and typing emojis means searching elsewhere and copying them in.

relations.evidence: obsidian-react-starter which the basis of v0.3.0+ is made from

summary: Emoji picker that lets you fuzzy-search and insert emojis into the editor via a hotkey or toolbar.
